**1 — Scene:** A mixed meal of creamy potato-and-green-bean salad, sliced roast meat, a small cheese-pizza slice, and cooked zucchini/yellow squash. The meat appears to be pork, though that is uncertain.

**2 — Vessel:** A large, roughly square dinner plate, approximately 27 cm across. Using a 27 cm circular equivalent gives an estimated usable area of **572 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Potato and green beans coated in creamy dressing; roast meat; pizza crust with tomato sauce and melted cheese; zucchini and yellow squash with a light oily coating. Dressing and cooking oil are included in the corresponding foods’ energy estimates.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:**

| Food, as plated | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Creamy potato–green bean salad | 46% | 263 cm² × 1.8 cm = 473 ml | 0.70 g/ml | 332 g | 150 | 498 kcal |
| Cheese-pizza slice | 12% | 69 cm² × 0.75 cm = 52 ml | 0.90 g/ml | 46 g | 270 | 124 kcal |
| Sliced roast meat | 12% | 69 cm² × 1.4 cm = 97 ml | 1.00 g/ml | 96 g | 210 | 202 kcal |
| Cooked zucchini/yellow squash, lightly oiled | 10% | 57 cm² × 1.4 cm = 80 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 48 g | 70 | 34 kcal |

The areas sum to **80% food coverage**, consistent with the visible empty plate around and between the foods.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **522 g and 858 kcal** is plausible for this substantially covered dinner plate, with most of the weight in the salad. Dressing quantity and meat fat content are the largest energy uncertainties.
